dog.description_text:
Meet Claws! 🐾 Claws is the perfect mix of chill and spunky. He’s a laid-back little guy who loves to relax, but his curious side always has him exploring and checking out what’s going on around him. He can be a little shy when he first meets you, but once he warms up, get ready — he’ll be all over you soaking up the love and attention! ❤️

Claws is great with other dogs and, with his sweet and easygoing personality, should do well with kids too. He’s currently learning to use his wee-wee pads and is getting the hang of his puppy routine. One thing he’s already mastered? Naptime! 😴 After breakfast, lunch, and dinner, Claws is more than happy to curl up for a good snooze.

He’s sweet, curious, playful, affectionate, and full of personality — the kind of pup who can keep you entertained and then happily settle in for some quiet time. Claws is looking for a loving forever home where he can keep learning, growing, cuddling, and, of course, napping. 🐶❤️.

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it's a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
